audit.whatIsWrong: Every timing instruction on the page is 'engage only on Rupture's cooldown', 'trade strictly on Rupture's timer', 'commit on Rupture's cooldown'. The number was never given, and the number destroys the advice.
audit.why: Rupture is 6 seconds at every rank. There is no cooldown window to wait for — Ambessa cannot stall six seconds inside his range. The real counterplay is the one the content layer already half-states: it lands after a delay on a visible circle, so you walk out of the telegraph and commit into the recovery. Telling a player to wait for a 6s ability to be down is telling them to stand still and get hit by it.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and report[5].t now give the 6s number and switch the instruction from waiting to dodging.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Get silenced mid-combo' and its description read 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown'. What the silence actually does to Ambessa is stated nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: Drakehound's Step only triggers when Ambessa enters an attack or movement command WHILE casting an ability. Feral Scream silences, so under it she cannot cast, and with no cast there is no dash at all — the silence does not just delay her combo, it removes her mobility. It is 11s at rank 1 in a 300-range cone, which is exactly the range she has to stand in.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[1] now state that a silence turns Drakehound's Step off entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was the generic 'the R lock isolates and finishes the chain — point it at the kill, not the tank', and Feast's cooldown appears nowhere.
audit.why: Feast is 80s at rank 1 against Public Execution's 130s — he gets his ultimate back roughly twice as often as she does, and it is true damage that a killing blow converts into permanent max health. Trading ultimates is a losing exchange for Ambessa on the clock alone.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now carries both cooldowns and states that Feast ignores armour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2's 'why' claimed 'dash-resets stack your passive shield mid-trade', and Levels 4-5 was the generic lane-control template.
audit.why: Drakehound's Step gives bonus attack range, damage, attack speed and an energy refund — no shield; Repudiation is Ambessa's only shield. At 4-5 her Q is 14-11s and E 13-10s against a 6s Rupture and an 11s Feral Scream, which is the actual reason that stage does not belong to her.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why and phases[3].why now state the real cooldown mismatch.

audit.why: The content layer already gets the itemisation logic right — it says his percent-HP true-damage ultimate ignores armour stacking and that flat armour pen cannot keep pace with his health pool. That matches Riot's Feast text and the resistances-invalidated flag in _missing-interactions.json, so no change was needed.

notes: Cho'Gath's kit file flags grounding on Rupture; Riot's own description is 'popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them' with no grounding in it, so I wrote it as a knockup plus slow and never told the player his Q denies her dash. Ambessa's file likewise flags grounding on Repudiation and grounding plus heal on Public Execution, none of which is in Riot's text for either ability, so no claim was made. The silence-kills-Drakehound's-Step point is a deduction from the two Riot descriptions together — her passive only fires while she is casting an ability, and a silence prevents the cast — not an outside source. Whether her suppression is affected by tenacity is not in the data and I made no claim.
